ValidationRule.description: VR.CALC.03 — Prevents Calc_Mode from being set to Manual or Hybrid without a linked Active_Mode_Change__c episode record. Mode transitions must go through CalcModeService to create the episode first.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Calc_Mode__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Calc_Mode__c, 'Manual'), ISPICKVAL(Calc_Mode__c, 'Hybrid') ), ISNULL(Active_Mode_Change__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Calc Mode Change episode must be created and linked before transitioning to Manual or Hybrid mode. Use the Mode Transition action to initiate the process.
